sources.supports: Reciprocal fully-qualified self and alternate hreflang; generic English alternatives; translated body and accessible language navigation; HTML hreflang is sufficient without duplicating the same annotation in sitemap.
Descriptive concise titles, avoiding stuffing; titles are not constrained to a fixed character count and may be rewritten/truncated.
Distinct useful descriptions; Google may select body text; no fixed meta description length guarantees visible snippets.
Crawlable standard img, descriptive contextual alt and text, supported WebP, representative page images, and large preview permission.
IPTC DigitalSourceType options for synthetic media; image metadata and licensing properties have distinct meanings; supplied metadata does not guarantee a Search annotation.
AI content should be reviewed for quality, accuracy and useful metadata; Merchant Center has specific AI image file metadata requirements distinct from ordinary editorial pages.
Canonical Schema.org enumeration member for trained algorithmic media, corresponding to the IPTC vocabulary; observed Schema.org V30.1.
The readable concept page uses HTTPS while its explicit Concept ID (URI), used for XMP DigitalSourceType, is http://cv.iptc.org/newscodes/digitalsourcetype/trainedAlgorithmicMedia.
Product snippet required properties include name and at least one of review, aggregateRating or offers; an editorial page must not invent these to force eligibility.
Markup and image representations must reflect visible relevant accurate page content; valid syntax alone does not guarantee rich-result display.
BreadcrumbList describes navigable page hierarchy using ordered named items and URLs.
Canonical URLs consolidate signals for duplicate or similar states; signals do not guarantee Google's canonical selection.
site: queries are not exhaustive; their absence cannot establish a page's index status.
Crawling, indexing and serving are distinct stages and none is guaranteed by following technical guidelines.
List absolute canonical URLs; only accurate significant update dates should be supplied; sitemap availability/submission does not guarantee indexing.
Owner verification, URL inspection, sitemap and indexing reports, and query/page/country performance are appropriate tools for actual Search visibility measurements.
